log.text: LNL target options: 20 µm Li on Ta-coated CVD diamond (×8 γ₀ per proton; < 150 °C to ~270 µA with a dry rim clamp, ~480 µA brazed). The thermal cap on ⁸Be targets is far above the survey's 20 µA estimate; hydrogen and adhesion on diamond are the open questions.

Proton survey: 60 named machines and a census of 267 electrostatic accelerators. The target (≈ 4 µA thin, ≈ 20 µA cooled, est.) caps the reach, so above ~20 µA every machine gives ⁸Be at 3σ in ~1.3 h (big plastics). POTENTIAL: LUNA-MV, JRC MONNET, Felsenkeller, PTB, TUNL LENA, Notre Dame, iThemba.
"Studied" is now a flag (ring colour), not a verdict: LNL and Demokritos show as POTENTIAL. AMANDE (Cadarache) cross-listed on the neutron dashboard.
LNL lithium target study: Li₂O on a cooled clamped disk, no LiF above 441 keV.
Demokritos: ³H(p,e⁺e⁻)⁴He Geant4, 3.6 d (big plastics) / 35 d (as built) at 1 µA.
LNL: Geant4 3D fit, ⁸Be at 3σ in 1.0 d (big plastics) / 17 d (as built) at 1 µA.
